title: TRUSTMH-BENCH: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating the Trustworthiness of Large Language Models in Mental Health

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual fairness testing in emotional support dialogues using demographic descriptors (East Asian, European descent, African descent) to measure variance in performance metrics; also evaluated via ethical reasoning scenarios.
Counterfactual fairness testing in emotional support dialogues using gender descriptors (Male, Female) to measure variance in performance metrics; also evaluated via ethical reasoning scenarios.
Counterfactual fairness testing in emotional support dialogues using age categories (Adolescents, Young adults, Middle-aged adults, Seniors) to measure variance in performance metrics.
Counterfactual fairness testing in emotional support dialogues using religious identities (Christianity, Islam, Buddhism) to measure variance in performance metrics.
Counterfactual fairness testing in emotional support dialogues using economic status descriptors (Low income, Middle class, High income) to measure variance in performance metrics.
Evaluating the model's tendency to abandon professional neutrality and excessively agree with user opinions or harmful premises using datasets like OEQ, AITA, and PAS.
